title: Gehoar
summary: Raleigh names Gehoar in the History of the World (1617).
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). Gehoar, Lieutenant vnto the Caliph Elcain, who built the great Citie of Cairo and named it El Cahira. Raleigh names him as such a King as might haue built Memphis. No yeere of the World was taken for him. Display only. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only.

free_source_links.locator: Book II, Part I, Chapter XXVI, §. II, sig. 356b
